treatment_phases.duration_text: Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity; dose 80 only if escalation criteria satisfied. Continued 60 or lower may be required.

treatment_phases.notes: Bevacizumab component only; confirm indication, companion regimen, phase and actual prescribed dose. Do not infer a fixed treatment duration or a partner schedule from the bevacizumab cycle. For frontline ovarian indication only: start bevacizumab at cycle 2, combine with chemotherapy for up to six cycles, then continue subject to maximum 15 months (22 cycles). Lung/platinum continuation follows up to six combination cycles; this limit does not apply to breast or erlotinib treatment.
